# Now let's create notes for all files in the directory
# We'll iterate through all file paths, read content, compute title, and create note
import os

sn_token = sn_login['access_token']  # fresh token from login

created_notes = []
for file_path in _mem['s9']:
    # Read file content
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=file_path)
    content = file_data['content']
    
    # Compute title: basename without .md, replace underscores with spaces
    basename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    title = basename[:-3]  # remove .md
    title = title.replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Create note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(
        title=title,
        content=content,
        access_token=sn_token
    )
    created_notes.append((file_path, title, result))
    print(f"Created note for {basename}: {result}")

print(f"\nTotal notes created: {len(created_notes)}")
